title: Affine chart coordinates and the local compatibility equations
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative local ring, $C$ its maximal-ideal adic completion [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion], $U$ the open complement of its closed point, $q:Y\to U$ and $s:E\to\operatorname{Spec}C$ finite morphisms [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism], and $D$ completion overlap data [def-sbc-punctured-completion-matching-sections]. Let $g:\operatorname{Fin}t\to A$ generate the maximal ideal. Put $V_j=(q\circ\iota_U)^{-1}(D(g_j))$, $O=Y\times_U(\operatorname{Spec}C\times_{\operatorname{Spec}A}U)$, $p:O\to Y$ its projection, and $v:O\to E$ the overlap map. Give $\Gamma(Y)$ and $\Gamma(E)$ their structural $A$-actions and $\Gamma(Y,V_j)$ the restricted structural action. Then the $V_j$ cover $Y$ and there exist formal gluing data $X$ for $A\to C$ and $g$ [def-weil-pbc-formal-glueing-data], $A$-linear equivalences $e:X.M'\simeq\Gamma(E)$ (after restricting scalars) and $d_j:X.M_j\simeq\Gamma(Y,V_j)$ such that, for every ambient tuple $(x',(x_j))$, membership in $H^0(X)$ [def-weil-pbc-formal-glueing-H0] is equivalent to both: (a) the sections $d_j(x_j)$ agree on every $V_j\cap V_k$; (b) on $p^{-1}(V_j)$ their pullbacks agree with the restriction of $v^*(e(x'))$ for every $j$. No global matching section or equivalence with the matching ring is asserted.

source.place: Tag 0BLH, first two proof paragraphs; Tag 05EL, the two compatibility equations defining H0.

proof.text: Prove the cover directly: if a point of Y lies in no V_j, its image prime contains every g_j and therefore the maximal ideal by hgen. Every prime of a local ring lies below the maximal ideal, so the image is the excluded closed point, contradicting hU. Also every D(g_j) lies in U since g_j belongs to the maximal ideal.

Apply exists_affine_coordinate_squares to the principal-open containment proved in step 1. Obtain X, structural A-linear coordinates e and d, and injective section identifications b and c satisfying the four numerator squares. This is only the affine construction; it asserts no H0 or cover result.

Unfold h0 into the two families of kernel equations using mem_inf, mem_iInf, mem_ker, and sub_eq_zero. In the forward direction apply c_ij to the alpha_overlap equation and rewrite its two numerator formulas to get IsCompatible. Apply b_j to the alpha equation and rewrite its two formulas to get the overlap equation (with equality reversed). Conversely apply injectivity of b_j and c_ij to the overlap and compatibility equalities, rewrite the numerator formulas, and obtain both families of h0 equations. The infLELeft/infLERight inclusion maps are unfolded to the displayed homOfLE maps.

proof_origin.place: Tags 0BLH and 05EL: chart cover and both directions of the kernel characterization proved in Lean; A-linear affine coordinate construction isolated in lem-sbc-punctured-completion-affine-coordinate-squares.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_formalGlueingData_affine_datum
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A]
    {U : (Spec (.of A)).Opens}
    (hU : ∀ x : Spec (.of A), x ∈ U ↔ x ≠ IsLocalRing.closedPoint A)
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} {q : Y ⟶ U.toScheme} [IsFinite q]
    {E : Scheme.{u}} {s : E ⟶ Spec
      (.of (AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A))} [IsFinite s]
    (D : CompletionGluingData A U q E s) (t : ℕ) (g : Fin t → A)
    (hgen : Ideal.span (Set.range g) = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) :
    let C := AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A
    let φ := algebraMap A C
    let V : Fin t → Y.Opens := fun j ↦ (q ≫ U.ι) ⁻¹ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (g j)
    let aY := ((ΓSpecIso (.of A)).inv ≫ (q ≫ U.ι).appTop).hom
    let aE := ((ΓSpecIso (.of A)).inv ≫ (s ≫ completionSpecMap A).appTop).hom
    letI : Algebra A Γ(Y, ⊤) := aY.toAlgebra
    letI : Algebra A Γ(E, ⊤) := aE.toAlgebra
    letI : ∀ j, Algebra A Γ(Y, V j) := fun j ↦
      ((Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : V j ≤ ⊤)).op).hom.comp aY).toAlgebra
    let O := pullback q (completionSpecMap A ∣_ U)
    let p : O ⟶ Y := pullback.fst q (completionSpecMap A ∣_ U)
    ⊤ ≤ iSup V ∧
    ∃ (X : FormalGlueing.Data.{u, u, u} φ g)
      (e : FormalGlueing.restrict φ X.M' ≃ₗ[A] Γ(E, ⊤))
      (d : ∀ j, FormalGlueing.piece (g j) (X.M j) ≃ₗ[A] Γ(Y, V j)),
      ∀ x : FormalGlueing.restrict φ X.M' ×
          ∀ j, FormalGlueing.piece (g j) (X.M j),
        x ∈ FormalGlueing.h0 φ g X ↔
          Y.presheaf.IsCompatible V (fun j ↦ d j (x.2 j)) ∧
          ∀ j, p.app (V j) (d j (x.2 j)) =
            O.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : p ⁻¹ᵁ V j ≤ ⊤)).op
              (D.toCompleted.appTop (e x.1))
